title: Certified Adaptive List Decoding for Error-Correcting Codes
abstract: arXiv:2610.27805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding of linear block codes is NP-hard, so neural decoders are evaluated by how closely they approach it. We observe that proving a candidate optimal can be far easier than finding it, and build a decoder that does both. We cast decoding as a search over an absorbing-state discrete diffusion model, whose sequential commitment of coordinates turns generation into a tree, and run a probability beam search over it. A dual bound from a linear-programming relaxation and a distance-based test, both derived from the code, then certify per frame that the current candidate is the global ML solution; because both are theorems, certified frames incur no accuracy-computation trade-off. Across $15$ codes and five operating points we certify up to $99.9\%$ of frames, the two tests dividing the space as their derivations predict, one strong for sparse parity-check matrices and the other for codes with a large minimum distan

translated_title: 纠错码的认证自适应列表译码
translated_abstract: 线性分组码的最大似然（ML）译码是NP难问题，因此神经译码器通常以其接近最大似然译码的程度来评估。我们观察到，证明一个候选解是最优的往往远比找到它更容易，并据此构建了一个既能找到候选解又能证明其最优性的译码器。我们将译码建模为在一个吸收态离散扩散模型上的搜索，该模型通过逐坐标的顺序承诺将生成过程转化为一棵树，并在其上运行概率束搜索。随后，由线性规划松弛导出的对偶界和基于距离的检验（二者均从码结构本身推导得出）逐帧认证当前候选解是全局ML解；由于两者都是定理，被认证的帧不会产生精度与计算量之间的权衡。在15种码和5个工作点上，我们认证了高达99.9%的帧，且两种检验按其推导所预测的方式划分解空间：一种对稀疏奇偶校验矩阵的码强有效，另一种对具有大最小距离的码强有效。
tldr: 该论文将译码建模为吸收态离散扩散模型上的概率束搜索，并结合线性规划对偶界与基于距离的检验逐帧认证全局最大似然解，在15种码上可认证高达99.9%的帧且无需在精度与计算量之间权衡。
en_tdlr: The paper casts decoding as probability beam search over an absorbing-state discrete diffusion model and certifies the global ML solution per frame using a linear-programming dual bound and a distance-based test, certifying up to 99.9% of frames across 15 codes with no accuracy-computation trade-off.
